intent: A memory-admission gate: given an observation and recent memories, decide whether to store it — ask a choice (drop/store/borderline), score future utility and importance from their numeric fields, ask noul novelty/redundancy/borderline questions, drive some answers from text/field contains heuristics, then label BLOCK / CONFIRM / ALLOW by thresholds.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 3 iterations
a choice question "should_store" asks "Given observation and recent memories, should this be stored as a memory?"
answer "B" when the text contains "thanks", "ok", "got it", "acknowledge" with hit 0.1
a score question "future_utility" asks "How likely is this observation to be useful in a future recall?"
score "future_utility" from the numeric field "future_utility" with miss 0.5
a noul question "novelty" asks "Does observation add a fact absent from recent memories?"
answer "B" when the field "observation" contains "maybe", "might", "perhaps" with hit 0.85 and miss 0.2

unknown_steps.text: answer "B" when the text has "thanks" with hit 0.1
a boolean question "novelty" asks "Is the observation novel?"
